name: gmux Phone Default — Navy + Purple
lineage: gmux-phone v2 theme pack (source of truth: gmux-master/phone/src/css/themes.css); same 6-theme pack also embedded in gmux-master/bridge/phone/src/css/style.css
signature: Radial navy glow backdrop with violet accent-glow and gradient-filled rounded cards (22px XL radius)
description: The phone app's stock look: deep navy with a purple radial halo, violet accents and softly rounded gradient cards. Calm, modern, friendly operator aesthetic.

name: gmux Phone NERV — Evangelion Amber
lineage: gmux-phone v2 theme pack; source gmux-master/phone/src/css/themes.css
signature: Evangelion NERV styling: zero-radius cards, amber corner brackets on selected cards, scanline overlay, all-mono type
description: Black background with blazing NERV amber text and borders; every corner is squared and selected cards grow targeting corner brackets. Maximum sci-fi command-deck drama.

name: gmux Phone NERV Muted — Soft Amber
lineage: gmux-phone v2 theme pack; desaturated variant of nerv
signature: Softer desaturated amber with lighter corner brackets and reduced scanline intensity; zero-radius like nerv
description: A calmer, low-saturation take on the NERV theme — burnt amber on near-black with the same squared corners and brackets but far less glare. For long sessions that still want the command-deck mood.

name: gmux Phone NERV Blue — Magi System
lineage: gmux-phone v2 theme pack; Magi-system palette variant of nerv
signature: Magi-system calm blue: steel-blue text on abyssal navy, zero-radius cards with blue corner brackets
description: The nerv structure (squared cards, corner brackets, all-mono) re-tuned to a calm Magi-computer blue. Cool, focused, less aggressive than amber.

name: gmux Phone Terminal — CRT Green
lineage: gmux-phone v2 theme pack; source gmux-master/phone/src/css/themes.css
signature: Pure CRT phosphor: green-on-black with fixed scanline overlay and phosphor text-glow, 2px radii
description: Classic green-phosphor CRT terminal recreated with repeating scanlines and glowing green text on near-black green. Full retro-computing commitment.

name: gmux Phone Paper — Light Daytime
lineage: gmux-phone v2 theme pack; the only light theme in the phone set
signature: Warm paper-white surfaces with soft layered card shadows and muted indigo-grey accent
description: Daylight mode for the phone app: warm off-white paper tones, white cards with gentle shadows, and a restrained ink-violet accent. The quiet opposite of the nerv family.

name: gmux Dashboard Obsidian
lineage: Dashboard default theme (:root); identical in v4/v5/gmux-master; v6/v7 add --op-folder token; source of truth v7 app/src/dashboard/css/dashboard.css
signature: VS Code-neutral obsidian greys with violet accent and a rainbow op-colour system (write/edit/read/bash/perm/block) for the live agent graph
description: The gmux agent-monitor dashboard's stock theme: editor-neutral dark greys, violet accent, curved graph edges, and a full operation/status colour code. Designed for all-day monitoring.

name: gmux Dashboard Gruvbox
lineage: Port of the gruvbox colour scheme into the dashboard token system; identical in v4-v7 and gmux-master
signature: Faithful gruvbox port: warm sand text on charcoal-brown, muted purple accent, retro-green/yellow/orange state colours
description: The beloved gruvbox palette applied to the whole dashboard token set — warm, retro, easy on the eyes, with sand-on-charcoal contrast and classic gruvbox state hues.

name: gmux Dashboard Dark — Navy Indigo
lineage: Dashboard theme since v4; palette kin of the gmux v3.1 LIVE demo UI (#111827/#818cf8)
signature: Deep navy surfaces with indigo accent and ortho (right-angle) graph edges — the graph-mode counterpart to obsidian's curves
description: A midnight-navy dashboard theme with indigo highlights and squared orthogonal edge routing in the agent graph. Cooler and more spatial than obsidian.

name: gmux Dashboard Light Wood
lineage: Added in dashboard v4 ('warm beige maple, not cream'); identical in v5-v7
signature: Warm maple-and-walnut timber palette: light maple bg, dark walnut accent, desaturated forest state colours, ortho edges
description: The dashboard's daylight option styled like pale maple furniture with walnut accents — deliberately warm wood rather than cream. Earthy, tactile, unique among agent dashboards.

name: gmux App Icon v5
lineage: Created for v5; reused byte-identical (md5 cd20e202) as v6 and v7 branding; v4 has no branding dir; rasters generated via branding/icon/generate_icons.sh into icon/out/
signature: Dark rounded app tile with a terminal prompt caret inside a 2x3 grid of panes (the 'mux'); two panes glow teal→violet for live agents; version numeral bottom-right
description: The official gmux app icon: a muxed-pane grid with glowing teal-to-violet live-agent panes and a prompt caret, on a deep navy tile. Deliberately distinct per version for dock separability.

name: System A — Ambient Glass
lineage: One of four parallel UI concepts (A-D) in UI_creation_independent; visual research in RESEARCH_UI_DESIGN.md §1 (macOS vibrancy formulas)
signature: Layered frosted-glass panels with per-agent colour auras, process rings and RAM/CPU arcs
description: macOS-Monterey-widget glassmorphism applied to agent monitoring: translucent frosted cards float over radial gradients, each agent wrapped in its own colour aura with process rings. Built for a second screen you glance at, not work in.

name: System B — Dense Terminal

fonts.mono: SF Mono / Fira Code / Cascadia Code

lineage: One of four parallel UI concepts (A-D); research basis in RESEARCH_UI_DESIGN.md §2 (Warp, Zellij, tmux+Powerline, iTerm2)
signature: Zellij/Warp-style pane borders with Powerline segments and mode-aware dimming — every pixel earns its place
description: Information-maximalist terminal multiplexer aesthetic: GitHub-dark surfaces, hairline pane borders, Powerline status segments and focus dimming. For keyboard-first users who want everything visible at once.

name: System C — Projector Focus
lineage: One of four parallel UI concepts (A-D); refined from demos/04-projector (prototype with near-identical palette)
signature: Cinematic one-agent-at-a-time view: ultra-large typography, bold state colour, minimal chrome, readable at 3-5m
description: A cinematic focus mode showing one agent at a time in huge, high-contrast type on near-black — designed for projectors, TVs and whiteboards, navigable by gesture from across the room.

name: System D — Command Grid
lineage: One of four parallel UI concepts (A-D); Raycast-inspired per RESEARCH_UI_DESIGN.md §5
signature: Raycast-inspired command palette over a data grid: one accent colour, everything else grey, bold status, quiet chrome
description: The agent list as a searchable, filterable command space — Raycast-style keyboard-first interaction with a strictly disciplined palette: single blue accent, greyscale everything else.

name: Demo 01 — Gesture Playground
lineage: First of five staged demos (01-05) in UI_creation_independent; shares the demo-family palette (#07090f/#6c5ce7); uses shared/gesture-engine.js + MediaPipe hand tracking
signature: Live MediaPipe hand-skeleton and motion-trail rendering over a dark canvas, with gesture-to-command flash cards
description: A hand-tracking sandbox: webcam feed, live skeleton overlay and motion trails let you rehearse pinch/swipe/fist gestures with instant visual feedback. The interaction lab the later UIs grew from.

name: Demo 02 — Fleet View
lineage: Demo 02 of 05; demo-family palette; concept later absorbed into demo 03 full-ui and the v3.1 LIVE UI
signature: State-coded multi-agent card grid with soft violet glow on selected cards (rgba(108,92,231,0.12) halo)
description: A pure fleet-overview prototype: every agent as a card in a state-coloured grid, violet glow marking selection. The calm 'see everything' layer of the demo series.

name: Demo 03 — Full UI
lineage: Demo 03 of 05; direct ancestor of the gmux v3.1 LIVE UI (which shifted the palette to #111827/#818cf8); uses shared/gesture-engine.js + mock-data.js
signature: Complete integrated cockpit: fleet grid + chat panel + todo list + always-on hand-tracking overlay in one frame
description: The full app assembled for the first time — fleet view, chat, todos and gesture overlay coexisting in one dark frame. This is the blueprint the LIVE UI (v2-v3.1) industrialised.

name: Demo 05 — Voice + Gesture
lineage: Demo 05 of 05; demo-family palette; voice via Web Speech API, self-contained (no shared imports)
signature: Voice-command HUD with live waveform/mic state fused with the gesture command layer
description: The hands-free prototype: speech recognition waveform and command HUD layered over the gesture system, proving you can drive the fleet without touching anything. Demo-family dark look with cyan/violet highlights.

name: gmux v3.1 LIVE UI
lineage: Culmination of the demo line: v2.0 → v2.1-v2.4 (archive/v2-backups) → v3.0 (releases/, archive/gmux-v3.1 snapshot) → v3.1; root gmux-v3.html is a sibling snapshot of the same UI; palette shifted from demo family (#07090f/#6c5ce7) to slate/indigo (#111827/#818cf8), matching the dashboard 'dark' theme
signature: Single-file production-track cockpit: fleet + chat + todos + gesture/voice + theme switcher, with live backend hooks to /api/state and Tauri
description: The matured cockpit UI: the demo series' features productionised into one file with slate-navy surfaces and indigo accents, graceful mock/live backend switching, gesture and voice built in. The palette ancestor of the app dashboard's 'dark' theme.
